messages:
incident-bot: paging @sre-oncall — SLO alert: p99 latency > 2.0s for /v1/generate on pool-gamma (rolling 5m). automated mitigation: none triggered.

maya (sre-oncall): ack, I'm awake, taking it. Can someone check which tenants are on pool-gamma?

kevin (sre): looking... tenant map shows heavy traffic from tenant-2314 and tenant-881. Tenant-2314 is doing large streaming sessions right now. p95 jumped from 180ms -> 1.1s, p99 ~ 2.3s.

jordan (runtime): confirming — telemetry shows continuous streaming stalls at the tail. KV cache hit rates okay, but I see NVMe IO queue depth spikes on the hosts backing pool-gamma.

lisa (prod-eng): any recent deploys to that pool?

infra-team-bot: deploy-bot: deploy successful: runtime-3.14 -> pool-gamma @ 2755554000 by jordan. No config changes.

sam (support): customer impact: tenant-2314 reported intermittent partial responses in-app. No error codes, just stalls. They opened a ticket ~2m ago.

kevin (sre): running quick iostat to confirm IO. snippet:

```
avg-cpu:  %user   %nice %system %iowait  %steal   %idle
          12.4    0.0    8.1    45.3     0.0    34.2
Device            tps    kB_read/s    kB_wrtn/s    kB_read    kB_wrtn
nvme0n1         4500      10240        8900     614400     532800
```

kevin (sre): iowait at 45% on affected hosts — that's our culprit. Also seeing cgroup throttling logs: `blkio.throttle.io_service_bytes` ramping up for docker/container for tenant-2314.

maya (sre-oncall): Could be noisy neighbor with heavy checkpointing / model warmup writes. Jordan — any scheduled jobs for tenant-2314?

jordan (runtime): tenant-2314 ran a large model quantization/merge yesterday; but nothing scheduled now. However, their client is doing long streaming sessions which cause frequent checkpoint writes for streaming KV to local disk.

lisa (prod-eng): We have a known bug where streaming flushes aren't batched when session > 30s. That could be hitting disk frequently. I'll link PR that fixes batching but it's not yet rolled.

maya (sre-oncall): Immediate mitigations: 1) throttle tenant-2314 at the routing layer to limit concurrent streams, 2) migrate tenant-2314 to a dedicated host pool (dedicated-gamma) if capacity, 3) temporarily bump blkio weight for other tenants to reduce their impact. Which is fastest?

kevin (sre): 1) throttle is quick — updating routing rule now.

```json
POST /admin/route/throttle
{ "tenant": "tenant-2314", "concurrency": 4, "reason": "io-contention-mitigation" }
```

kevin (sre): done — rule applied, propagation ~30s.

maya (sre-oncall): monitoring.

(30s later)

kevin (sre): p95 dropped to 420ms, p99 down to 1.1s. iowait reduced to 28% on hosts. Streaming stalls less frequent but still visible.

jordan (runtime): migration attempt: there's one empty slot in dedicated-gamma, can live-migrate tenant-2314 containers to dedicated hosts. ETA ~4m. Planning migration now.

infra-team-bot: action: started migration job mig-7752 -> targeted hosts: gamma-dedicated-02.

lisa (prod-eng): FYI that migration will change observed latency slightly due to network hop but should remove noisy neighbor IO. Also will avoid pooled NVMe contention.

(3m later)

infra-team-bot: migration complete: tenant-2314 moved to dedicated-gamma-02.

kevin (sre): p99 now 560ms, p95 200ms. No tail stalls observed for last 2m.

sam (support): I told tenant-2314 support contact we throttled and migrated to reduce their errors. They want root cause and ETA for permanent fix.

maya (sre-oncall): short RCA draft: noisy neighbor IO from tenant-2314 streaming sessions caused high NVMe iowait on pool-gamma hosts, resulting in p99 SLO breach for /v1/generate streaming. Immediate mitigations: routing throttle + live migration to dedicated host. Status: mitigated, customer impact material (partial stalls observed), no data loss.

lisa (prod-eng): permanent fix options: 1) land streaming flush batching PR (reduces frequent small writes), 2) enforce per-tenant blkio cgroup limits to cap IO, 3) add proactive scheduling to avoid placing heavy streaming tenants on same NVMe devices. Prioritize (1) and (2).

maya (sre-oncall): next steps: - create an incident ticket and severity classification (sev3 -> because customer-facing partial stalls, short duration). - coordinate with product and eng to prioritize PR for batching. - infra to propose automatic placement rule for heavy IO tenants.

kevin (sre): created incident ticket INC-2026 with timeline and metrics. Assigning to lisa + infra.

sam (support): Customer-facing note: "We've mitigated the issue by moving your workload to an isolated host and throttling while we implement a longer-term fix. We don't expect further stalls, will follow up with root-cause and timeline." Sending now.

maya (sre-oncall): handing off to kevin for long tail/monitoring. I'm off at 18:30. If anything regresses ping @sre-oncall.

kevin (sre): ack, taking over monitoring. Will post final postmortem once eng and infra have patch timeline.

jordan (runtime): logging: attaching detailed traces and iostat from affected hosts to INC-2026.

infra-team-bot: note: flagged hosts for follow-up: pool-gamma-hosts [g-gamma-01,g-gamma-02,g-gamma-03] — disk firmware/queue settings being reviewed.

maya (sre-oncall): thanks team. closing active paging for now. :white_check_mark:
